Hi Lauren — thanks for the materials and timeline. Quick notes and requests from our side to prep for redlines: 

1) Party details: can you confirm the full legal entity name (including DBAs), billing address, and the signatory name + title who will sign the MSA? We need exact strings for Exhibit A and signature block.
2) Hosting/residency: you indicated US staging + prod — can you confirm if there are any EU/UK users or data flows that require cross-border clauses?
3) Security evidence: please attach your most recent SOC 2 Type II report (if available) or point us to where we can get it. Our GC will want to reference it in Exhibit B.
4) Order form: I can map fields from your filled sheet into our order-form exhibit. Are there any purchase order numbers or internal contract IDs we should include?

I'll loop in Marissa (Legal) for scope/redline strategy and Jonas (Contracts) to manage the order-form mapping and DocuSign flow. Our plan:
- Legal will run a first-pass redline against Piquant's MSA focusing on indemnity, liability cap, data residency, and termination for convenience.
- Contracts will produce a mapped order form and an exhibit A draft for signature.

Can you send the SOC2 and confirm the signatory by EOD? We will aim to return initial redlines by Tuesday 2027-04-20.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Sr. Contract Manager, Redwood Inference

- Jonas: map fields from piquant_orderform_filled.xlsx into Redwood Order Form template, include PO PIQ-PO-4738 — deliver draft 2027-04-18.

Notes for Piquant:
- Please confirm whether Matthew Rios will sign electronically or needs a wet signature. Electronic is preferred and speeds the DocuSign route.
- We'll insert a standard SOC2 reference in Exhibit B and request the unredacted report if the contract escalates.
- Redlines: unless we see unusual commercial exposure, we plan to be fairly standard on liability limits but will propose a mutual indemnity structure and clearer data-processing definitions.

I'll attach our redline (PDF) after the initial pass. If Piquant wants to accelerate, please let us know and we can prioritize the liability and data sections.

Best,
